create_forum_post: create a new forum post with an author, title, and content using ForumState.create_post
reply_to_forum_post: reply to an existing forum post by post_id using ForumState.reply_to_post
upvote_forum_post: upvote a forum post by its post_id using ForumState.upvote
parse_and_execute_forum_action: parse a JSON action string and execute post, reply, upvote, or downvote via ForumState.parse_and_execute_action
get_forum_summary_for_player: get a personalized forum summary showing new posts and replies for a specific player using ForumState.get_forum_summary_for_player
